page_title: NAP 3-0 BOL | Napoli v Bologna 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' 3 - 0 Goal! David Neres plays it to Giovanni Simeone (Napoli), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lukasz Skorupski. 3:0.
90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Santiago Castro (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
90+2' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
88' Matteo Politano comes off the pitch to be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
86' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replaces Giacomo Raspadori.
82' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
80' Here comes a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Michel Aebischer.
79' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Napoli will take a corner kick.
79' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Matteo Politano (Napoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Napoli get a corner.
77' Here comes a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).

75' 2 - 0 GOAL 2:0! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
74' 5:4 – the corner kicks stats.
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Alex Meret was alert and the score remains the same.
67' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' That's the end of the game for Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), who is replaced by Jens Odgaard.
63' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Miranda (Bologna) replacing Charalampos Lykogiannis.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dan Ndoye (Bologna) trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jesper Karlsson.
62' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Michel Aebischer (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
56' The expression of the referee Luca Pairetto is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is shown a yellow card.
56' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lukasz Skorupski reads it well and gathers the ball.
55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Now Napoli have a corner.
53' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing. Bologna earn a corner.
50' Stefan Posch (Bologna) has received a yellow card for his foul.
49' Yellow card! It's like Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Luca Pairetto agrees and books him.
48' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
47' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret is equal to it and makes an easy save.
46' Referee Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia puts a cross into the box and finds Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
45+1' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' A dangerous looking corner kick from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.

45' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
43' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) for a tough tackle.

43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
41' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.

41' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
38' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is first to arrive to a high rebound just outside the box and attempts to score with a header, but the keeper blocks it.
37' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
36' Ball possession – 35:65.
34' Poor challenge! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle.
30' Santiago Castro (Bologna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Alex Meret.
28' Nikola Moro (Bologna) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.

28' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.
24' The foul by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

22' Matteo Politano (Napoli) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
19' Problems for Vincenzo Italiano as Martin Erlic is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) replaces him.
17' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
13' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
12' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
11' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul after Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
9' A player from Bologna brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
6' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

5' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Lukasz Skorupski was alert and the score remains the same.
3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
2' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will officiate today.
